title: AnalyseTool organization policy
description: policy.json — machine layer (%ProgramData%\AnalyseTool\policy.json) or organization layer (joined by URL). Every section is optional. See docs/enterprise-deployment-design.md.

policyUrl.description: Pointer form: the real policy lives at this https URL, file-system path or source: reference. The plugin follows it (organization layer, enforced or not).

enforced.description: Pointer form: the user cannot leave the organization. Meaningful only when the target is not user-writable.

signingKey.description: Pointer form: base64 SubjectPublicKeyInfo (ECDSA P-256). When present the policy at policyUrl must carry a valid policy.json.sig.

update.description: Where a seat below minimumVersion gets the installer, and its hash.

locked.description: Settings the user may not change. A value present but not locked is only a default.

enabled.description: Allow ad-hoc C# execution (ExecuteRevitCode). Recommended: false + locked.

roots.description: Additional extension source folders (dev zone, not removable). %ENV% is expanded; 'source:<name>/<relative>' resolves a named source (see 'sources'). Synced OneDrive/SharePoint folders work: assemblies are loaded from a byte copy.

catalogUrl.description: Company catalog (catalog.json shape): an https URL (cached with its ETag) or a file-system path with %ENV%. Merged after the shipped catalog and before the user's; user entries cannot override it.

allowedFeeds.description: Prefix whitelist for install sources and update feeds: 'github:owner/' or 'https://host/path/'. Absent = everything allowed.

required.description: Extensions every seat must have: installed when missing, updated when the feed is newer, never disabled or removed by the user. Applied in the background after startup.

sha256.description: Pins the package; a download that does not match is refused.

allowInstallFromRepository.description: False refuses the free-form 'Install from repository…' paste; catalog entries still go through allowedFeeds.

enabled.description: Whether the in-Revit MCP bridge may run.

sources.description: Named sources referenced as 'source:<name>/<relative>' anywhere a path or URL is expected. Exactly one of sharepoint / path / url per entry.

sharepoint.description: Library or folder URL (https://<tenant>.sharepoint.com/sites/<site>/<library>/<folder>); resolved to this machine's OneDrive mount point.

path.description: UNC share or local folder; %ENV% expanded.

markerId.description: Fallback: id inside analysetool-source.json at the folder root, found by scanning OneDrive mount points.

syncUrl.description: The odopen:// link SharePoint's Sync button produces; offered when the library is not synced on this seat.
